vocabulary.meaning_en: time alone to think clearly about things
vocabulary.example: I took a week off to get some head space.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to think carefully about something for some time
vocabulary.meaning_ar: يقلّب الأمر في ذهنه؛ يفكّر مليًّا
vocabulary.example: Let me chew things over and call you tomorrow.
After a long meeting, we came to a decision.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a decision that will not change

vocabulary.example: I've never managed a team, but I'll give it a go.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to feel sorry about something you did or decided
to stop working for a while to rest or think
vocabulary.example: She took time out to think about her future.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the moment when you must decide
vocabulary.example: It's decision time for the team.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say yes to an offer
a feeling of not being sure
vocabulary.example: There's no doubt that she is the best person for the job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: knowledge and skill you get from doing something
vocabulary.example: I need the experience of managing people.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make a place clean and in order
vocabulary.example: Please tidy up your desk before you leave.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to feel sad because someone is not with you
vocabulary.example: Everyone in the office misses her.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person whose job is to sell a company's products
vocabulary.example: Anna is the company's newest sales executive.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when people understand something in different ways
vocabulary.example: There has been a misunderstanding about the date.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an offer or plan that you ask someone to agree to

vocabulary.example: I'm back! Did I miss anything?
She is one of the brightest people in the company.

fine_lines.title: decide vs decision
fine_lines.explanation_ar: decide فعل (يقرّر)، وdecision اسم (قرار). مع الاسم نستخدم أفعالًا مثل make أو come to: make a decision / come to a decision، ولا نقول do a decision.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Decide is a verb; decision is a noun. With the noun use make or come to: make a decision, come to a decision. Don't say 'do a decision'.

examples.sentence: I decided to accept the job.
I've come to a final decision.

fine_lines.title: chew vs chew things over
fine_lines.explanation_ar: chew وحدها تعني «يمضغ» الطعام. أما chew things over فتعبير معناه «يفكّر في الأمر طويلًا وبعناية».
fine_lines.explanation_en: Chew alone means to bite food many times. Chew things over is an idiom: think about something carefully for a long time.

examples.sentence: I need a few days to chew things over.

expressions.phrase: I have had some head space and a chance to chew things over.
expressions.meaning_ar: حظيت ببعض الوقت للتفكير بصفاء وفرصة لتقليب الأمور في ذهني.
expressions.meaning_en: I had time alone to think carefully.
expressions.example: I've had some head space and a chance to chew things over, and I'm ready to answer.

expressions.phrase: I've come to a final decision.
expressions.meaning_en: I have decided, and I won't change it.
expressions.example: After a long week, I've come to a final decision: I'll take the job.
Managing the London office is a big job, but I'll give it a go.

expressions.meaning_en: You will be happy with what you decided.
expressions.example: Welcome to the team - you won't regret your decision.

expressions.meaning_en: I say yes to your offer.
expressions.example: I've thought about your offer. The answer is 'yes'. I accept.

expressions.phrase: What's the worst thing that can happen?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما أسوأ ما يمكن أن يحدث؟
expressions.meaning_en: Said to show that trying is not too risky.
expressions.example: Let's try the new plan. What's the worst thing that can happen?
There's no doubt really - this is the right choice.

grammar.title: Present perfect to announce a decision: I've come to… / I've had…
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما نعلن قرارًا أو نتيجة تفكير، نستخدم المضارع التام have/has + التصريف الثالث، لأن الحدث وقع في الماضي ونتيجته مهمة الآن: I've come to a final decision، I've done a lot of thinking.
grammar.explanation_en: To announce a decision, use the present perfect (have/has + past participle): the thinking happened before, but the result matters now. I've come to a final decision. I've done a lot of thinking.
examples: I've come to a final decision.
We've decided to open a new office.
I've had time to think about it.

grammar.title: Emphatic do/did: I did have some head space
grammar.explanation_ar: لنؤكّد أن شيئًا حدث فعلًا، نضع do/does/did قبل الفعل في المصدر في جملة مثبتة: I did have some head space (حظيت فعلًا ببعض الوقت).
grammar.explanation_en: To make a positive sentence stronger, put do/does/did before the base verb: I did have some head space (= I really had).
examples: I did read your email - I just forgot to reply.
We did try to call you.

grammar.title: won't + verb to reassure: You won't regret…
grammar.explanation_ar: لطمأنة شخص بشأن المستقبل نستخدم won't (= will not) + الفعل: You won't regret your decision.
grammar.explanation_en: To reassure someone about the future, use won't (will not) + verb: You won't regret your decision.

questions.question: 'Chew things over' means…
questions.explanation_ar: chew things over أي يفكر في الأمر مليًّا.
questions.explanation_en: It means think about something carefully.

questions.question: I've ___ to a final decision.
questions.explanation_ar: المضارع التام: I've + التصريف الثالث come.

questions.question: 'Head space' is…
questions.explanation_en: Head space is time to think clearly.

questions.question: You won't ___ your decision.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد won't يأتي الفعل في المصدر.
questions.explanation_en: After won't, use the base verb.

questions.question: 'I'll give it a go' means…
questions.explanation_ar: give it a go تعني سأجرّب.

questions.question: Which is correct?
questions.explanation_ar: نقول make a decision أو come to a decision.
questions.explanation_en: We say 'come to a decision' or 'make a decision'.

questions.question: What does Anna ask Tom to do when she returns?
questions.explanation_en: She asks him to tidy his desk.

questions.question: 'I did have some head space.' Why does Anna use 'did'?
questions.explanation_ar: did هنا للتأكيد في جملة مثبتة.

Which sentence announces a decision?
choices: I've decided to accept the offer.
